The lfs.net vehicle mod 'BAVARIA A46 SEDAN 30I' says it contains copyrighted material from Sketchfab under 'CC Attribution (BY)', with the BMW E46 M-Sport model by Ricy (@ngon_3d) as the source.
candidates.notes: This is the best licence match found for a stock 330i sedan. The LFS mod credits this Sketchfab model as its source, which suggests Ricy made it (the Sketchfab model came first; it isn't a rip of the mod). One search summary briefly called the mod 'BY-ND', but the lfs.net licence field reads CC Attribution (BY) and so does the Sketchfab listing. Check the licence and any NoAI tag on the live page before download. It's mid-poly, so the interior and engine bay are probably basic or missing (not stated). The M Sport bumpers and skirts are a factory 330i option, not a fantasy kit. It needs a credit on /credits.

candidates.title: BMW M3 E46 (Blend Swap)
candidates.author: Andrei Maximov
candidates.evidence: Search results: made in Blender 2.68 and rendered in Cycles, and the .blend file includes 5 studio environments in separate scene and render layers. The author called it 'a short 3 week project' on Blender Artists. The Sketchfab copy (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bmw-m3-e46-6c1b23073ba34b5c9ef86152092a7af5) isn't marked downloadable.
candidates.notes: The Blend Swap licence (CC-0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA or CC-BY-NC are all possible on that site) wasn't visible in the results, so check it on the page. Only CC-0 or CC-BY would be allowed. It's an old 2013-era file and would need PBR conversion.

rejected.title: CR's BMW E46 M3 Sports Car
rejected.reason: It's sold under the Sketchfab Store royalty-free licence (70.6k triangles, with an added interior). But the seller says it's built from another uploader's free, now-deleted M3 GTR model with extra interior parts from a SketchUp model, so they may not have the right to grant a commercial licence. Treat it as a rejection unless the owner wants to look into it.

rejected.title: BMW M3 E46 (Most Wanted edition), BlenderKit
rejected.reason: It's the M3 GTR race car in the NFS Most Wanted livery, not the road M3 coupe. The BlenderKit royalty-free licence (173,894 polygons) also needs the paid Full plan.

items.searchNotes: Accessed 2026-09-26 using WebSearch results only. Queries covered Sketchfab ('BMW M3 E46', 'Buy Royalty Free', named uploaders), CGTrader ('BMW M3 E46 3D model | CGTrader', CSL, high poly interior), TurboSquid (site:turbosquid.com, 'editorial', listing id 1690326), SQUIR, Hum3D/3DModels.org, Blend Swap and BlenderKit. Gaps: the TurboSquid listing 'bmw-m3-e46-model-1690326' (https://www.turbosquid.com/3d-models/bmw-m3-e46-model-1690326) appeared but the results showed no title details, licence or price. A CGTrader 'BMW M3 e46 CSL' exists (YouTube preview), but its listing URL and details weren't found. No candidate with a confirmed modelled engine bay and an acceptable licence turned up. Not checked because the search budget ran out: 'BMW M3 E46' by BadKarma (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bmw-m3-e46-c2b0331b64574e03b63d28d3350d522f; licence and details not seen) and '2002 BMW M3 (E46)' by DisneyCars/@supercarmodels (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/2002-bmw-m3-e46-cc948b0e391b42c1bae76daaebd2f219; licence and origin not seen). Reference only: the Illumaesthetic 'BMW M3 (E46) 3D Scan' (Artec Leo, about 0.5 mm accuracy, 17M polygons, STL and BLEND, 750 MB; licence and price not seen). It could help check accuracy but isn't a render asset. Many free E46 M3s on Sketchfab come from NFS or Forza, so avoid anything mentioning GTR, NFS or Forza.

candidates.title: Jackboys Mazda RX7 FD High Detailed 3D Model
candidates.author: hlol911
candidates.evidence: Search results for the CGTrader listing: Royalty Free licence, 174,484 vertices, OBJ/FBX/BLEND, by hlol911. It's rigged with RigACar, has an engine modelled under the hood (1.3 rotary), a 'JDM styled interior', modelled headlights and taillights, customisable colours, and pop-up headlights that open and close.
candidates.notes: This is the only RX-7 found that confirms both an engine under the hood and an interior. How detailed the engine and bay are isn't stated. 'Jackboys' refers to the RX-7 in the Travis Scott JackBoys video, and 'JDM styled interior' suggests aftermarket styling, so check it against a stock FD3S (wheels, aero, cabin). Price not seen.

candidates.title: Mazda RX-7 FD3S Efini
candidates.author: MGR '99 (@MGR99)
candidates.evidence: Search results: the Sketchfab Store listing 'Buy Royalty Free 3D model by MGR '99', 4.5M triangles and 2.4M vertices. The same seller has an older store listing, 'Mazda RX7 FD' (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/mazda-rx7-fd-90597e9ed8e74937a4ae8de016bfccf5), marked 'OUTDATED' and described as a stock Mazda RX-7 FD efini.
candidates.notes: The Efini badge is correct for the Japanese-market FD3S, and the seller describes it as stock. At 4.5M triangles it's far over budget and would need heavy decimation and baking to fit 25 MB, though the detail suggests a real interior (not confirmed). Buy the current Efini listing, not the outdated one. Price and NoAI status not seen.

candidates.title: Mazda RX7 FD Turbo 1995 JDM

A free listing (https://www.cgtrader.com/free-3d-models/car/racing-car/mazda-rx7-fd-turbo-1995-jdm) gives 279,970 polygons and 171,883 vertices with unwrapped UVs, published 2021-05-11.
candidates.notes: It has aftermarket TE37 wheels and modified headlights, so it's not fully stock and the wheels would need swapping for stock FD rims. Interior and engine bay aren't stated. The free listing's licence wasn't seen, so use the paid Royalty Free one.

items.searchNotes: Accessed 2026-09-26 using WebSearch results only. Queries covered Sketchfab ('Mazda RX-7 FD3S', store listings), CGTrader ('RX-7 FD interior engine', FD3S, 'FD Turbo 1995', named listings) and TurboSquid ('RX-7 FD3S'). The session's web-search budget (200 calls) ran out partway through this item, so some leads weren't checked: 'Mazda RX-7 Type-RS (FD3S)' and 'Mazda RX-7 Spirit R (FD3S)' by Mona x Supercars (@Car2022) (free; licence and origin not seen), 'Mazda RX-7 FD3S Abflug' by @0verly, 'Mazda RX-7' by wallon, 'Mazda RX-7 FD' by Lexyc16 (licence not seen; the same author's E46 M3 is CC BY-NC, so it may be too), 'Mazda RX-7 Custom' by Naudaff3D (Sketchfab Store royalty-free; the name suggests it's modified), 'Mazda RX-7 FD' by Dimensionalworks on BlenderKit (licence not seen), CGTrader 'Mazda RX-7 FD3S Abflug Anibus 1994' (Abflug aero kit, not stock; licence and price not seen), and a low-poly CGTrader 'Mazda RX-7 FD3S' (OBJ/3DS/FBX/STL/DAE/X3D; nothing else seen). Check the Jackboys and MGR '99 pages for price and NoAI before buying.
